name: sammie porch pool service llc
services: Pool pump & motor repair and replacement

reviews.text: Sammie is the consummate professional. He is reliable, trustworthy, knowledgeable and resourceful. He transformed my mother's neglected pool - which looked like a green cesspool - into a beautiful, sparkling, aqua pool.
reviews.author: Becker Holland (Google review)

reviews.text: Sammie was the only one who could find the issue with the pipes on our pool. He showed up early, worked hard and had it fixed in less than an hour. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Angi Trapp

reviews.text: Was referred to Sammie Porch from another pool company. Had a clog in my return line. Came out the same day and cleared the clog quickly. Great communication.
reviews.author: Ronald Hall (Google review)

source_notes: No website and no Facebook page could be found for this business (confirmed sammieporchpoolservicellc.com does not resolve - nx_domain_error). Phone and hours cross-verified across two independent directory listings (local.yahoo.com and HomeProsVerified.com), both matching the GBP data pulled via Nimble location search (rating 4.9-5.0, ~55-58 reviews, place_id ChIJwbWHPEjiwogRf6phQ6Z_YnA, address 4675 19th Ave S). Owner name confirmed via Florida Sunbiz entity L17000016228 ('SAMMIE PORCH POOL SERVICE, LLC'): the Authorized Person/Member (AMBR) on file is 'PORCH, SAMMIE' at the same principal address - not a third-party registered-agent-for-hire. This is corroborated by 9+ independent Google/HomeProsVerified reviews (2023-2025) that all address him directly as 'Sammie' or 'Sam', plus a 2013 St. Petersburg city business filing for 'Sammie's Pool Cleaning & Lawn Care / Sammie Porch' tying the same person to pool work in the same city for over a decade. Review quotes pulled from the Google-reviews mirror on reviews.birdeye.com (unclaimed profile) and HomeProsVerified.com; two more attributable quotes were available (Ty; Michael Cordeiro; Kevin Stuteville; Emily Parsons) but only the strongest 3 were kept. No owner-uploaded photos were located anywhere (no Facebook page, no website, and the directory profiles use generic placeholder art only) - none were fabricated or substituted with stock/customer images.
